content: नि {%ind.%} (Mostly used as a prefix to verbs and nouns, rarely as an adverb or preposition.) It is used in the following senses (according to <ls>G. M.</ls>):-- .²1 Lowness, downward motion (‘down’, ‘under’, ‘below’); निपत् निषद्. .²2 A group or collection; निकर, निकाय. .²3 Intensity; निकाम, निगृहीत. .²4 Command, order; निदेशः .²5 Continuance, permanence; निविशते. .²6 Skill; निपुण. .²7 Restraint, confinement; निबन्ध. .²8 Inclusion (‘into’, ‘in’); निपीतमुदकम्. .²9 Proximity, nearness; निकट. .²10 Insult, wrong, harm; निकृति, निकार. .²11 Showing; निदर्शन. .²12 Cessation; निवृत्. .²13 Resort, refuge; निलय. .²14 Doubt. .²15 Certainty. .²16 Affirmation. .²17 Throwing, giving <ab>&c.</ab> (according to Durgādāsa). .²18 निमिच्छतिनिर्मिच्छति To perform Nīrājana or the ceremonial waving of lights round an object of worship or an idol; also round a person or horses or elephants as an auspicious act; कुरुते तमेव निमिच्छप देवः सफलं स जन्म <ls>N. 7. 43</ls>.
